meta.title: Hunt & Haul
meta.subtitle: Open-world hunting game for Roblox: drive out, hunt animals and bosses, haul carcasses and eggs back to your barn, shred for coins, hatch eggs, upgrade, repeat.

phases.name: World
phases.goal: A walkable, optimized map with the player base laid out.

phases.name: Vehicle
phases.goal: The truck drives the whole map and carries cargo.

phases.name: Core loop
phases.goal: Shoot one animal, haul it home, shred it for coins. End to end.

phases.name: Progression
phases.goal: Eggs, shop, saving. Players have a reason to come back.

phases.name: Content
phases.goal: Full animal roster, zones and boss fights.

root.title: Hunt & Haul
root.summary: The whole product. Every branch below rolls up into one loop: drive out, hunt, haul back, shred and hatch, upgrade.
acceptance: A new player can complete the full loop in under 10 minutes
Holds 60 FPS on mid PC, 30 FPS on mid phone
risks: Scope creep before the core loop is fun
Map too large for mobile memory

children.title: World & map
children.summary: The open world: terrain, mountains, river, road, forests, props, and the gameplay layout on top of it.
acceptance: Every zone reachable by truck
No buried or floating assets
risks: Blender to Roblox import limits (2048-stud mesh cap)

children.title: Map creation (Blender)
children.summary: AlpineValley_Optimized scene: 4096 x 4096 studs, 256 terrain chunks, mountain ring, valley floor, road, trails, river, waterfall gorge.
acceptance: Terrain chunks import under 2048 studs each
Ground texture matches reference clips
risks: Assets placed under the terrain surface
children.notes: Scene audit found River_water and all 4 bridges sitting below the ground surface, and the 04_Waterfall camera inside the terrain. Fix before export.

children.title: Fix buried river and bridges
children.summary: Raise or carve: River_water sits at z 1.3 where ground is ~31; Bridge_-90, Bridge_172, Bridge_-390 and StoneBridge top out below ground.
acceptance: Ray check: every water/bridge object above terrain

children.title: Vegetation pass
children.summary: 1,608 oaks, 833 pines, ferns, flowers, dry grass, shrubs. Reduce to instanced variants for Roblox.
acceptance: Trees reuse MeshIds so Roblox instances them
risks: Trees rooted into steep rock on the mountain apron

children.title: Import pipeline
children.summary: Export FBX by category, import with Studio's 3D importer, align to origin, set materials and collision.
acceptance: Scale is 1:1 (one Blender metre = one stud)
Collision: terrain precise, decor box or none

children.title: Map design (gameplay layer)
children.summary: Where things go and why: base location, hunting zones by animal, boss arenas, roads, difficulty gradient outward from the barn.
acceptance: Easy animals within 300 studs of base
Each boss arena at least 1,000 studs from base

children.title: Hunting zones
children.summary: Meadow (chickens, rabbits), forest (deer, boar), riverbank (ducks), rocky apron (goats), gorge and ridges (bosses).
acceptance: Zones do not overlap
Each zone has 8+ spawn points

children.title: Boss arenas
children.summary: 3 to 5 set-piece spots: waterfall gorge, clock tower, ridge clearing, deep forest.
acceptance: Arena fits a truck and 4 players

children.title: Roads, trails and ramps
children.summary: Road loop plus dirt trails so every zone is drivable; jumps and ramps for fun.
acceptance: Truck reaches every zone without getting stuck

children.title: Points of interest
children.summary: Hunting stands, ammo caches, dynamite crates, lookout points.

children.title: Lighting & atmosphere
children.summary: Bright cartoon sky with cumulus clouds, warm sun, light atmosphere; optional day/night cycle.
acceptance: Matches reference clips side by side

children.title: Map optimization
children.summary: StreamingEnabled, instanced MeshParts, collision fidelity rules, part-count budget.
deliverables: Budget sheet: tris and parts per zone
acceptance: Under 1.5 GB client memory on mobile

children.title: Player base (barn & hut)
children.summary: Home: the barn and hut, the square hatching pen, the shredder, truck parking and spawn.
acceptance: Player spawns at their own base
risks: Per-player plots on a shared map need clear separation

children.title: Barn & hut
children.summary: Red gambrel barn already modelled. Interior storage and spawn point.

children.title: Hatching pen (square area)
children.summary: Fenced square next to the barn with egg slots and incubation timers.
acceptance: Egg placed, timer runs while offline, hatches on return

children.title: Shredder
children.summary: Drop carcasses in, coins come out. Upgradable speed and payout.
acceptance: Payout matches animal value table
Server-side only

children.title: Truck unloading zone
children.summary: Back the truck into the zone and cargo auto-transfers: carcasses to the shredder queue, eggs to the pen.

children.title: Per-player plots
children.summary: Each server slot gets its own base; 'My Plot' button teleports home.
acceptance: Up to 8 plots per server, no overlap

children.title: Player & character
children.summary: The duck avatar, camera modes, inventory, and carrying things.

children.title: Duck avatar & animations
children.summary: Idle, walk, run, aim, reload, throw, carry.

children.title: Camera modes
children.summary: First person for shooting, third person on foot and in the truck.
acceptance: Switches cleanly when entering/leaving truck

children.title: Inventory & hotbar
children.summary: Weapons, dynamite, carried item slot.

children.title: Carrying system
children.summary: Pick up a carcass or egg, carry it (slower walk), load it onto the truck bed.
acceptance: Only one heavy item carried at a time

children.title: Vehicle: the truck
children.summary: Reuse the existing driving scripts. The truck is how you reach zones and how you bring loot home.
deliverables: Drivable truck on the full map
acceptance: Drives every road and trail
Carries up to 6 items
risks: Existing driving code may assume flat ground

children.title: Chassis & physics
children.summary: Port the existing driving files: suspension, wheel friction, acceleration, braking, steering.
acceptance: Climbs map slopes
No flipping on normal turns

children.title: Seats & enter/exit
children.summary: Driver plus passengers for co-op.

children.title: Cargo bed
children.summary: Slots for carcasses and eggs, visual stacking, weight slows the truck.
acceptance: Cargo stays on during jumps

children.title: Dashboard & radar
children.summary: Radar/compass like the reference clip, speed, cargo count.

children.title: Flip recovery & respawn
children.summary: Auto-right button; respawn truck at base.

children.title: Truck upgrades
children.summary: Engine, tyres, bigger bed.

children.title: Weapons & combat
children.summary: Data-driven guns, dynamite, and the feel of hitting things.
acceptance: Shooting feels responsive at 150 ms ping

children.title: Gun framework
children.summary: One module, every gun is a config: damage, fire rate, spread, recoil, mag size, reload time, range falloff.
acceptance: New gun added with config only

children.title: Aiming & scopes
children.summary: Hip fire, aim down sights, scope overlay for the rifle.

children.title: Hit detection
children.summary: Client raycasts for responsiveness; server re-validates distance, line of sight and fire rate.
acceptance: Rejected: hits through walls, faster than fire rate

children.title: Dynamite
children.summary: Throw arc, fuse, explosion radius damage and knockback.
acceptance: Does not damage the map

children.title: Combat feel
children.summary: Muzzle flash, tracers, hit markers, impact particles, screen shake, sounds.

children.title: Melee (bat)
children.summary: Fallback weapon from the reference clip.

children.title: Animals & AI
children.summary: What you hunt: roster, spawning, behaviour, death and drops, and boss fights.
risks: Too many active NPCs hurts server performance

children.title: Animal roster
children.summary: Tiers common to legendary. Each: HP, speed, damage, coin value, egg type, zone.
deliverables: Roster table (start: chicken, rabbit, deer, boar)

children.title: Spawner
children.summary: Per-zone caps, respawn timers, rarity rolls; despawn far from players.
acceptance: Server under 60 active animals

children.title: Behaviour
children.summary: Wander, graze, flee on gunfire, aggressive types charge.

children.title: Death, carcass & egg drop
children.summary: On kill: ragdoll into a carryable carcass, roll an egg drop.
acceptance: Carcass persists 3 minutes

children.title: Hit zones
children.summary: Headshot multiplier.

children.title: Boss fights
children.summary: Unique models, phased attacks, arena trigger, health bar, big loot and rare egg, server-wide cooldown.
acceptance: 4 players can beat boss 1 in 3 to 5 minutes

children.title: Loot & economy
children.summary: Coins in, upgrades out. Values that make the loop feel good.
acceptance: First upgrade within 5 minutes of play
risks: Inflation if bosses pay too much

children.title: Shred value
children.summary: Coins per carcass by animal, rarity and weight.

children.title: Eggs & pets
children.summary: Eggs hatch into pets that give buffs (speed, damage, auto-collect).

children.title: Shop
children.summary: Guns, ammo, dynamite, truck and barn upgrades.

children.title: Levels & rebirth
children.summary: XP from kills unlocks zones and guns; rebirth for long-term players.

children.title: Index (collection book)
children.summary: Every animal and egg discovered.

children.title: UI / UX
children.summary: HUD, menus and mobile controls.
acceptance: Everything usable on a phone

children.title: HUD
children.summary: Ammo, health, coins, cargo count, compass.

children.title: Menus
children.summary: Shop, index, inventory, settings, rebirth.

children.title: Mobile controls
children.summary: Fire, aim, throw, drive buttons.

children.title: Notifications
children.summary: Boss spawned, shop restocked, egg hatched.

children.title: Multiplayer & data
children.summary: Server authority, saving, co-op, anti-exploit.
acceptance: No data loss across 1,000 test sessions

children.title: Client/server remotes
children.summary: RemoteEvents for shooting, damage, loot, purchases. Server decides.

children.title: Saving (DataStore)
children.summary: Coins, inventory, pets, eggs and timers, upgrades, index, rebirths. Autosave and session lock.

children.title: Co-op & friend boost
children.summary: Shared truck, shared boss loot, friend boost multiplier.

children.title: Anti-exploit
children.summary: Server-side damage, speed and teleport checks, purchase validation.

children.title: Audio & polish
children.summary: Ambience, weapons, animals, music, particles.

children.title: Ambience
children.summary: Birds, wind, river by zone.

children.title: Weapon & animal SFX
children.summary: Per gun, explosion, animal calls and hit reactions.

children.title: Music
children.summary: Exploration loop and boss theme.

children.title: Monetization
children.summary: Gamepasses and dev products that don't break the economy.

children.title: Gamepasses
children.summary: 2x coins, VIP truck, extra hatch slot.

children.title: Dev products
children.summary: Coin packs, dynamite packs, lucky eggs.

children.title: Testing & launch
children.summary: Performance targets, playtests, analytics, soft launch.

children.title: Performance pass
children.summary: 60 FPS mid PC, 30 FPS mid phone; memory budget.

children.title: Playtests
children.summary: Weekly internal sessions from Phase 3 on; track time-to-first-upgrade.

children.title: Analytics
children.summary: Session length, loop completion, retention D1/D7.

children.title: Soft launch
children.summary: Public release with a small marketing push; iterate on data.
